excerpt: The PADME experiment proposes a search for the dark photon (A0 ) in the e+ e− → γA0 process in a positron-on-target experiment, exploiting the positron beam of the DAΦNE linac at the Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati, INFN.
publisher: M. Raggi et al. / DHF2014 proceedings (EPJ Web of Conferences) / arXiv
title: The PADME experiment at LNF
